verification.validation: AppShell forwards the UI's aside: the #aside slot, v-model:aside, v-model:aside-width and aside-dock. Frontend vitest for the shell (app-shell, app-shell-aside, app-shell-phone-tabs and the other shell tests), typecheck and vite build against UI 0.25.10, a browser check in Syngle at 1280 and 1024 in a DSM window and on a full page and at phone width, sdk-version and executor manifest checks, and an internal-content scan of the packed npm tarballs. No full gate, target matrix, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: AppShell forwards the UI's aside on every page: an #aside slot (an AsidePanel), v-model:aside and v-model:aside-width, kept by AppShell when not bound. Without the slot nothing changes.
aside-dock: 'wide' docks an open aside beside the page, with its resize handle, in a DSM window at least 960px wide (UI 0.25.10 or later).
